units.leftText: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to those who are called, sanctified by God the Father, and kept for Jesus Christ:
units.rightText: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to them that are called, beloved in God the Father, and kept for Jesus Christ:

units.leftText: May mercy, peace, and love be multiplied to you.
units.rightText: Mercy unto you and peace and love be multiplied.

units.leftText: Beloved, while I was very eager to write to you about our common salvation, I was constrained to write to you exhorting you to contend earnestly for the faith which was once for all delivered to the saints.
units.rightText: Beloved, while I was giving all diligence to write unto you of our common salvation, I was constrained to write unto you exhorting you to contend earnestly for the faith which was once for all delivered unto the saints.

units.leftText: For there are certain men who crept in secretly, even those who were long ago written about for this condemnation: ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into indecency, and denying our only Master, God, and Lord, Jesus Christ.
units.rightText: For there are certain men crept in privily, even they who were of old written of beforehand unto this condemnation, ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness, and denying our only Master and Lord, Jesus Christ.

units.leftText: Now I desire to remind you, though you already know this, that the Lord, having saved a people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed those who didn’t believe.
units.rightText: Now I desire to put you in remembrance, though ye know all things once for all, that the Lord, having saved a people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed them that believed not.

units.leftText: Angels who didn’t keep their first domain, but deserted their own dwelling place, he has kept in everlasting bonds under darkness for the judgment of the great day.
units.rightText: And angels that kept not their own principality, but left their proper habitation, he hath kept in everlasting bonds under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.

units.leftText: Even as Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them, having in the same way as these given themselves over to sexual immorality and gone after strange flesh, are shown as an example, suffering the punishment of eternal fire.
units.rightText: Even as Sodom and Gomorrah, and the cities about them, having in like manner with these given themselves over to fornication and gone after strange flesh, are set forth as an example, suffering the punishment of eternal fire.

units.leftText: Yet in the same way, these also in their dreaming defile the flesh, despise authority, and slander celestial beings.
units.rightText: Yet in like manner these also in their dreamings defile the flesh, and set at nought dominion, and rail at dignities.

units.leftText: But Michael, the archangel, when contending with the devil and arguing about the body of Moses, dared not bring against him an abusive condemnation, but said, “May the Lord rebuke you!”
units.rightText: But Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses, durst not bring against him a railing judgment, but said, The Lord rebuke thee.

units.leftText: But these speak evil of whatever things they don’t know. They are destroyed in these things that they understand naturally, like the creatures without reason.
units.rightText: But these rail at whatsoever things they know not: and what they understand naturally, like the creatures without reason, in these things are they destroyed.

units.leftText: Woe to them! For they went in the way of Cain, and ran riotously in the error of Balaam for hire, and perished in Korah’s rebellion.
units.rightText: Woe unto them! for they went in the way of Cain, and ran riotously in the error of Balaam for hire, and perished in the gainsaying of Korah.

units.leftText: These are hidden rocky reefs in your love feasts when they feast with you, shepherds who without fear feed themselves; clouds without water, carried along by winds; autumn trees without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;
units.rightText: These are they who are hidden rocks in your love-feasts when they feast with you, shepherds that without fear feed themselves; clouds without water, carried along by winds; autumn trees without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;

units.leftText: wild waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.
units.rightText: wild waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, for whom the blackness of darkness hath been reserved for ever.

units.leftText: About these also Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied, saying, “Behold, the Lord came with ten thousands of his holy ones,
units.rightText: And to these also Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied, saying, Behold, the Lord came with ten thousands of his holy ones,
leftNotes: 1:14 “Behold”, from “ἰδοὺ”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.

units.leftText: to execute judgment on all, and to convict all the ungodly of all their works of ungodliness which they have done in an ungodly way, and of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.”
units.rightText: to execute judgment upon all, and to convict all the ungodly of all their works of ungodliness which they have ungodly wrought, and of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.

units.leftText: These are murmurers and complainers, walking after their lusts—and their mouth speaks proud things—showing respect of persons to gain advantage.
units.rightText: These are murmurers, complainers, walking after their lusts (and their mouth speaketh great swelling words), showing respect of persons for the sake of advantage.

units.leftText: But you, beloved, remember the words which have been spoken before by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.
units.rightText: But ye, beloved, remember ye the words which have been spoken before by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ;

units.leftText: They said to you, “In the last time there will be mockers, walking after their own ungodly lusts.”
units.rightText: that they said to you, In the last time there shall be mockers, walking after their own ungodly lusts.

units.leftText: These are those who cause divisions and are sensual, not having the Spirit.
units.rightText: These are they who make separations, sensual, having not the Spirit.

units.leftText: But you, beloved, keep building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit.
units.rightText: But ye, beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit,

units.leftText: Keep yourselves in God’s love, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to eternal life.
units.rightText: keep yourselves in the love of God, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life.

units.leftText: On some have compassion, making a distinction,
units.rightText: And on some have mercy, who are in doubt;

units.leftText: and some save, snatching them out of the fire with fear, hating even the clothing stained by the flesh.
units.rightText: and some save, snatching them out of the fire; and on some have mercy with fear; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh.

units.leftText: Now to him who is able to keep them from stumbling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory in great joy,
units.rightText: Now unto him that is able to guard you from stumbling, and to set you before the presence of his glory without blemish in exceeding joy,

units.leftText: to God our Savior, who alone is wise, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and forever. Amen.
units.rightText: to the only God our Saviour, through Jesus Christ our Lord, be glory, majesty, dominion and power, before all time, and now, and for evermore. Amen.
